text_block_list.text:
One day, when yet another joint practice hosted
by the U.A.F. management was scheduled to take place—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "—Thank you very much for your cooperation on this matter."

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
No. If anything, I'm sorry this is all I can help with.
I will do my absolute best from here on out.
A senior Trainer will be participating as a supervisor starting from this joint practice session—
She took on the role of watching over the athletes to ensure they could practice safely, while also offering advice and guidance based on her own experience and knowledge.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Likewise, I look forward to working with you.
Now then, without further ado, what comes next—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Ahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...If it isn't Trainer!
Waaaah~! It's been so long!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"Long time no see, Elfi.
I'm so glad to see you're doing well."

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. When Elfie was at the academy,
I was her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"No, I apologize for bringing this up so suddenly.
I have somewhat personal reasons for consulting you about this..."

"...The 'personal reason' my senior Trainer mentioned back then
might have been about Sonon Elfie."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
—Even so, to think that the person supervising us
would be you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I'm back to training with you again, Trainer.
It's a little nostalgic!

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
I'm counting on you today.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, everyone!
Let's push each other to the limit and strive for greatness!!

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Haha—
She really never changes, does she?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Was it, after all, for Elfi's sake
that you lent us your aid this time?

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: ...Half of it is true, yes.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"As you know very well, Ms. Tsurugi,
Elfi is a very cheerful, straightforward girl.
She was always like that back when she was at the academy, too."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"—Trainer!
What are we starting with today!?
I'm completely ready to go!!"

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: ""I was looking forward to it so much yesterday that I was working out even in my dreams!""

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
...Rather than loving running itself, she simply loves moving her body.
She looks like she's having fun no matter what training she does—

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: I've seen many Umamusume up until now, but she left an especially cheerful impression among them.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"...Yet she was never able
to shine brightly in the racing world."

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer!
How was my last run?!
I showed everything you taught me!!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
""Yeah, you gave it everything you had.
...That took some serious guts.""

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
""I will never forget today's race!
I'll cherish this memory for the rest of my life!""

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
She kept up a cheerful front until the very end,
but in my heart, I worried whether
it might leave a scar on her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: ...That isn't just limited to her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same way toward all of my past students...
all the Umamusume who have retired.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: I wondered if the harsh days of competition and setbacks at the academy had left any scars on her.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder if there was something more
I could have done for them—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"...When you've been doing this job for as long as I have,
those kinds of prayer-like wishes tend to grow."

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I only wish that all the Umamusume
who have retired from racing... can find happiness
out there, wherever they may be.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: Yes, it was precisely because that was the wish—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
“—Hello there!
I love sports, and shining sweat connects the world!”

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: "Your thrilling athletic UmaTuber, Sonon Elfie, here!!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her joyful as ever, trying to
spread the wonderful joy of sports—

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: It really fired up my heart, you know?

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: "That's why I want to support my former student with all my might as she shines in a new place. And at the same time—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
I want to help create a stage where many Umamusume athletes can shine outside of racing too.
...That is the entirety of my reason.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ――The feeling is mutual.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Ah—
No... excuse me.
After the joint practice, a meeting was set up alongside a senior trainer to share compiled reports on the participating athletes' conditions with Ryoka Tsurugi, but—

Ryoka Tsurugi usually gave off a calm and composed impression,
but today, she seemed to be lost in thought quite often.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"...Pardon me.
I was lost in thought for a moment—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: ...It must be tough having to manage the event while keeping such a close eye on the runners.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
How about it? Care for some fresh air to clear your head?
Since we're here, I could show you around the academy a bit.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you
for looking out for me.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Then, if you'd be so kind, I'll take you up on that—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: This is...

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's a dirt track
that Elfi used often as well.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: I can still remember how happily she was warming up, and the way she ran up to me with all her might the moment she noticed me.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: That girl has been that way since way back when, hasn't she...—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Actually, I've known about Elfi ever since she was active in races.

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my—
Is that so?"

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
As someone involved in entertainment,
there was a time when I studied
the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—I happened to catch her debut race at the track,
and Elfi was running in it.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her celebrate victory with her whole body
looked so joyful... and so dazzling—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't take my eyes off her.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: After that, my days were filled with following her races, cheering her on, riding the emotional rollercoaster of every win and loss—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"When you win, I feel happy as if it were my own victory...
And when it's a close loss, I feel just as frustrated as if it happened to me."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
It feels as though another world has overlapped
with the one I'm seeing...
and that sensation is so very warm—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: “—Seeing Elfi give her all in races has inspired me time and time again.”

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Even when I felt like stopping in my tracks,
just connecting with the pure 'joy' radiating
from her entire being was enough to—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I was able to keep moving forward, again and again...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Precisely because I had watched her hoofprints
for so long—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: "...I'll never forget the feeling I had after Elfie's final race came to an end."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"This is really, truly the last time
we'll ever get to see her run," I thought.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ......That really took a toll on me, I must admit.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
And so, a little time passed,
and just as my feelings were finally settling—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: I found out that Elfie started streaming.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Watching her enjoy sports just like she used to when she ran in races—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Memories of cheering for them back then
vividly came rushing back...――

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Words cannot fully express the joy I felt back then...

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: "...Elfie is truly blessed. After all, she had someone who cheered for her this much."

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text:
"I completely understand how you felt
when you found Elfi again, Ms. Tsurugi."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"...Seeing someone you used to root for
thrive on a brand-new stage,
and feeling your heart warm with passion."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
"That might be something that could happen
to anyone, not just you and me, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
Even at this very moment, there must be someone
striving to shine on a new stage.
And someone who longs to see that radiance once more—
choice_data_list: It'd be wonderful if the U.A.F. could be that stage, wouldn't it?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
If it could happen to anyone... then—
What I should have done was...—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, an idea came to me—a way that might get even more people interested in the U.A.F.

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Aah! So this is where you all were!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
You weren't in your room, so I went looking for you!
Is the debriefing already over?

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I was taking a short break.
And while I was at it, I was being shown around the academy—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
I see!
Still, this place really brings back memories, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: We sure ran a lot...

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ...Elfie was—

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: Elfie... have you ever thought about returning to racing?

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: Not at all!!!

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text:
"Because Trainer and I
gave it our absolute best!"

text_block_list.name: Trainer in a Hat
text_block_list.text: Elfie...

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: And right now—

text_block_list.name: Sonon Elfie
text_block_list.text: As a thrilling athletic UmaTuber! I'm trying to do my absolute best here!!

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text: ......Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Ryoka Tsurugi
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you both for your concern.
Let's continue our debrief.

In the eyes of Ryoka Tsurugi as she smiled,
I could see a fierce, passionate glimmer—
